text: Steenbarger: it holds as ADVANCE. day_vol 1.17 under 1.40 is O'Neil's bar, not mine; it is above the name's own normal, and fill difficulty is not served (R5). My test is trend then new high (C5): W 0.1% under 20-wk high, D 0.1% under 20-day high, H1 99% of range, all HH/HL with 9>21. The hourly close over yesterday's high IS that new high; waiting for a daily close on 1.4 risks missing the move (C5). I would clear to WAIT only on a danger signal: a fade of 1 atr_14d (atr 4.19, my translation) from the day's high, or a daily close under ma_20.
